posts.text: The US and Israel’s war with Iran has fundamentally reshaped the Middle East. Iran’s old guard is gone, America’s alliances with Israel and the Gulf Arab states are being tested and the Strait of Hormuz has become one of Iran’s most potent weapons of war. At @aspenideas, I sat down with @ksadjadpour, @KimGhattas and @mdubowitz to discuss these shifting dynamics.
